t: Flomasta MDPE 20mm push-fit stop cock offers quick and easy isolation of water supplies. Push-fit demountable design provides a leak-free seal that ensures reliable performance. Features stainless steel teeth for a secure grip, and an anti-debris seal that protects the internal mechanism from blockages. Compatible with poly pipe systems in both residential and commercial settings. 16 bar rated for handling tough pressure demands.
